liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Help On The Way** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the Help, Slipknot, Franklin's sequence smokin'; Reviewer calls the Help>Slip>Franklin's a classic that takes its time [19][22]
- **The Wheel** (2 reviews): Reviewer says this show includes the first Wheel; Reviewer believes this marks the band's first live performance of The Wheel; vocals are good and Donna is on key [17][21]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Reviewer says this show includes the first Cassidy [17]

## Setlist highlights

- **Dancing In The Street**: back after 235 archived shows (1616 days) [29]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Samson & Delilah [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-06-03.sbd.seamons.fix-20004.86745.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 182 min; rated 4.62/5 by 13 [1]
- **gd76-06-03.sbd.bertha-ashley.20004.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 188 min; rated 4.2/5 by 40 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the tape runs slow, about a half step flat in key; Some circulating copies have lower pitch; reviewer thinks this copy is right but sounds slightly slow; Reviewer says the soundboards are off pitch because of the recording chain, not just band tempo, checked against a guitar [20][22][24][25][26]
- **gd76-06-03.aud.vernon.7825.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 181 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording has a nice sound mix [21]
- **gd1976-06-03.mtx.seamons.91912.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 201 min; rated 4.47/5 by 19 [4]
- **gd1976-06-03.148568.fob.sony.ecm18n.lee.smith.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 199 min [10]
- **gd1976-06-03.sbd.bertha.17266.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 177 min [14]
- **gd76-06-03.sbd.serafin.7719.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 164 min; rated 4.68/5 by 28 [16]

## Around the show

- Oregon fans have long called this one the heroin show [24]
- Band returned after a nearly 20-month break, apart from three 1975 shows, the longest gap between tours in their history [17]
- Reviewer says Samson, Supplication, Lazy Lightning and Wheel were played for the first time here [19]
- Reviewer says the slow feel reflects 1976 playing: the band relearning material and back to two drummers [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-06-03.sbd.seamons.fix-20004.86745.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Pitch correction by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro; source: SBD>>MR>>DAT>>WAV>>SHN>>DAW(Bertha)>>CDA/SHN - [1]
- **gd76-06-03.sbd.bertha-ashley.20004.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd76-06-03.aud.vernon.7825.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Dale Shepherd; source: Audience Recording [3]
- **gd1976-06-03.mtx.seamons.91912.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Matrix by Hunter Seamons; source: MATRIX MIX: SBD/AUD (About 60%/40%) [4]. Also: Audience source recorded by Pat Lee, 15th row front of balcony, handheld Sony ECM18N mics onto cassette with Dolby B; Noah Weiner transferred the cassette to digital in November 2002; Hunter Seamons later made a matrix with Final Cut Pro in 2008 [4]
- **gd1976-06-03.148568.fob.sony.ecm18n.lee.smith.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Pat Lee; transferred by Matt Smith and Scott Clugston; source: Pat Lee's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes ; Sony ECM18N mics (10-20 rows back from stage, hand-held) > Sony TC-152 (2 x Maxell UD 120) [10]
- **gd1976-06-03.sbd.bertha.17266.shnf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: SBD>>MR>>REEL>>PCM>>DAT>>WAV>>SHN>>DAW(Bertha)>>CDA [14]. Also: Soundboard digitally remastered on a custom dual-DAW nicknamed Bertha in August 2002; This soundboard version is missing One More Saturday Night and The Wheel [14]
- **gd76-06-03.sbd.serafin.7719.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [16]. Also: This soundboard source lacks the encore; reviewer recommends the other soundboard version over this one [19]
